Transfers between two NovaBank accounts are free of charge. Local transfers to other UAE banks cost AED 2 per transfer when made through the mobile app or online banking, and AED 10 when requested at a branch. International transfers (SWIFT) cost AED 30 per transfer. Correspondent bank charges may be deducted by intermediary banks and are outside NovaBank's control.

Instant transfers between NovaBank accounts cannot be cancelled once confirmed. A scheduled transfer can be cancelled from the app until 11:59 PM on the day before its execution date. To recall an international transfer that has already been sent, the customer must contact the call centre. A recall is not guaranteed and a recall fee of AED 50 applies.

The default daily limit for transfers through the mobile app and online banking is AED 50,000 per customer, across all accounts. Customers can raise the daily limit up to AED 250,000 from the app under Settings > Limits. Any increase requires one-time-password (OTP) confirmation, and the new limit becomes active after a 12-hour cooling-off period. Transfers to a newly added beneficiary are limited to AED 10,000 during the first 24 hours after the beneficiary is added.
